note: Patterns that map the compiler's first error to a class of the model's CheckError, tried in order. A failed instantiation's first error carries the note of the constraint that failed. Every pattern for a message that quotes a name of the program's, of a variable, a field, an argument, a function, a method or a type, is matched whole (^...$), with each such name a quoted '[^']*', and all of them come first, above every loose pattern: a loose pattern is searched for anywhere in the message, so a name that holds its word, such as a 'mut' parameter named 'uninitialized' or a function named 'immutable', would send the message to the wrong class (#219, #271). scripts/test_conformance.py fails when a pattern with a name slot, a wildcard that can match a quoted name such as '[^']*', '.+' or a bare .*, is not a single ^...$ with no | outside a group, or sits below a loose pattern, one that is not such a single ^...$; and when a recorded message that quotes a name reaches a pattern without a name slot first. The loose patterns stay below for wordings that the pin has not shown, and where they need a wildcard they use [^']*, which cannot span a quoted name. ''T' value has no attribute 'copy'' comes before ''T' value has no attribute 'A'': the compiler reports .copy() of a value that is not Copyable as a missing attribute, the model as notCopyable. ''T' value has no attribute 'A'' is the compiler's error for an unknown field and for an unknown method alike, on any type. 'does not designate a value with an origin' is the compiler's error for moving an element out of a list or an array, or a value out through a 'ref' binding; it comes before escapingReference, whose loose pattern also matches 'origin'. 'use of invalidated interior reference' is the compiler's error for a reference to a list element used after the list changed. ''V' is uninitialized at (the implicit )?return from this function' is the compiler's error for a 'mut' parameter or the 'self' of '__init__' left partly uninitialized when the function returns. 'invalid use of mutating method on rvalue' is the compiler's error for a 'mut self' method called on a value that cannot be changed, such as 'p^' or a 'read' parameter, and 'value passed to mutable argument 'A' must be mutable' its error for such a value passed to a 'mut' parameter, for a 'mut' argument that is a call returning an immutable reference, and for a temporary passed 'mut'; the model reports the first two as immutablePlace, and a temporary as notAPlace (#81). 'has non-'Deinitable' type' is the compiler's error for a struct on a cycle of structs made only of list and array edges, and 'attempt to resolve a recursive reference to declaration' its error for a struct that holds itself by value, directly or through other structs, or through arrays alone when the structs have a __deinit__. Which of these cycles the model accepts, and the compiler bugs among them (D-0004, D-0006), is in docs/decisions/conformance-classes.md, Cycles of structs. 'does not conform to trait 'Writable'' is the compiler's error for printing a value that print cannot write. 'aliasing values passed immutably' is the compiler's error for a location passed immutably that a 'mut' argument of the same call aliases, such as a returned reference and the place it points into. 'no matching function in initialization' is the compiler's error for every initialization whose arguments fit no initializer: a construction with wrong arguments, a literal that does not fit the list or array it initializes, and List[T](...) with arguments or from a source that is not a list or an array of T, or range(...) of Int arguments with T an Int. 'cannot construct 'T' with itself, you can remove the constructor call' is its error for the same misfit when the one argument has the type T itself, such as List[T](xs) from a List[T] whose elements cannot be copied (#103). 'function instantiation failed: constraint failed: expected N elements in the SIMD list literal, found M', the failed instantiation with its note, is its error for a literal of any length but 1 where an Int, SIMD[DType.int, 1], is expected (D-0005). 'no matching function in call to 'NAME'' is its error for a call of a function with several overloads, none of which its arguments fit, a wrong number of them included: List[T](range(...)) whose arguments fit no form of range (#121), and len of a Bool, None or a struct without Sized (#190). All four are noMatchingInit, matched whole, so that no other message reaches that class. ''V' used with all fields manually initialized but without calling an '__init__' method' is the compiler's error for a struct built field by field and then used whole, which the model reports as uninitializedUse, as the compiler does for a part of one (#51). 'no matching method in call to 'NAME'' is the compiler's error for a call of a method or an operator with several overloads, none of which its arguments fit, a wrong number of them included: an operator of an integer literal, an index of a list or an array, and a list's pop (#88, #169). ''T' does not implement the '__X__' method' is its error for an operator whose operand's type lacks the operator's method, and for a call of a variable, whose type lacks __call__ (#176). 'cannot synthesize copy constructor because field 'F' has non-copyable type 'T'' and 'cannot synthesize implicit copy constructor because field 'F' has non-implicitly-copyable type 'T'' are the compiler's errors for a struct that declares Copyable, or ImplicitlyCopyable, with a field that cannot be copied so; both are uncopyableField (#164). 'invalid call to 'F': missing required argument: 'A'' and 'invalid call to 'F': unexpected argument' are the compiler's errors for a call of a function or a method, __call__ included, that leaves out one or more required arguments, of which it names only the first, or that passes more positional arguments than it takes; both are arityMismatch (#209, #219). ''__X__' requires N operands' is the compiler's error for an operator method declared with the wrong number of operands, self among them, such as __add__(self) or __bool__(self, k: Int); it is arityMismatch too (#214). ''T' is not subscriptable, it does not implement the `__getitem__`/`__setitem__` methods' is the compiler's error for a subscript, read or assigned, of a Bool, of None or of a struct that declares neither method; it is notAList (#182). 'invalid call to 'NAME': violated constraint' is the compiler's error for a call whose constraint on the parameters of the callee's type fails, such as two arrays compared whose element type does not conform to Equatable, or to Comparable to order them; it is violatedConstraint (#166). 'cannot use a dynamic value in type specification' and 'cannot use a dynamic value in a parameter list' are the compiler's errors for a type, or a type inside List[...] or Array[...], whose name a variable or a parameter in scope hides; both are valueAsType (#193), matched whole.
